# `company.shipment_package_contents`

Immutable: the units of one shipment line in one box.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this content row. |
